Note: Steal See is a Korean Arcade Game published by Eolith in 2000. The game has a couple of stolen images from various Hentai Visual Novels from the 90s as well as some illustration cds used in the game,I managed to find the sources for some of these images thanks to reverse image search sites like SauceNAO,but some of these images are very hard to find on these sites. Let me know in the comments if you can identify Some of the images I posted from the Game on this Gallery Set
